2. Financial Report Clarifications
We understand the need for additional clarity around the financial report, particularly on ADA tracking and the forecast for events from May to December 2025. Please see the following clarifications:

Currency Use and Conversion:
All project-related payments were made in Euros by team members and collaborators. These were then reimbursed in ADA based on the rate applicable at the time of the expense (not all reimbursements have been done). As such, the current report lists actual amounts in Euros because these were the real out-of-pocket expenses covered upfront (primarily by Mariana). ADA values will be used during the reimbursement process, and a conversion will be applied accordingly at the time of reimbursement.
Team Compensation and Allocation:
The ADA budget was allocated as follows: Mariana – 43%, Nina – 37.5%, Raz – 7%, and Other team members – 12.5%. These allocations cover both compensation and expenses incurred.
